facts.text: At the undergraduate level, Marymount University requires every student to complete an academic internship providing at least 200 hours of practical experience.

sources.title: Internship Process for our Students - Marymount University
sources.quote: At the undergraduate level, the internship is required and is usually completed in the senior year. Students receive at least 200 hours of practical experience, for which they will earn 3 academic credits.
